description: Cyclotourisme - Segments cyclables is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données correspond aux segments des itinéraires et boucles de cyclotourisme sur la Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ces données sont également disponibles en WFS:. Coverage: Région Centre-Val de Loire. The publisher named on the listing is Région Centre-Val de Loire. Its keywords include tourisme, culture-tourisme, velo, geospatial, cyclotourisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
